message.content:
This editorial illustration features a hooded figure standing against a background of orange and yellow wavy, flame-like patterns. The central figure wears a blue-grey zip-up hoodie with the hood pulled up, concealing the upper face in shadow. A dark grey pleated mask covers the lower face. Below the hoodie, the figure wears camouflage-patterned trousers in shades of green, black, and brown. Hands are placed inside the hoodie's front pockets.

Large white block letters at the top read "TEMPO," with smaller text "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" underneath. Above this, text reads "Modus Pemerasan Immanuel Ebenezer H.32" and "Dampak Ekonomi Setelah Penjarahan Rumah Sri Mulyani H.86." To the left, large black text states "DI BALIK RUSUH UNJUK RASA," followed by a paragraph starting with "Polisi menemukan peran tentara..." and ending with "H.68." At the bottom left, text indicates "8-14 SEPTEMBER 2025," "RP 60.000," and other publishing details, alongside a barcode and QR code. A white numeral "51" is partially overlaid on the "O" of "TEMPO."
